items.title: Product Launch System
items.kicker: On-site project · Sr. AI Researcher · Aug 2026 – present
items.summary: AI automation with a human in the loop: one unified system that connects three teams, from programme sheet to print-ready, editable designer artwork. In use as an internal tool.
items.body: Launching a new programme meant a brochure and its launch material, and that work moved between three teams that never shared one tool: product managers who own the facts and the story, a content team that reviews and approves…

blocks.text: Launching a new programme meant a brochure and its launch material, and that work moved between three teams that never shared one tool: product managers who own the facts and the story, a content team that reviews and approves every word, and designers who rebuild the approved pages by hand in Adobe Illustrator. Each hand-off was an email, a PDF and a round of corrections, and the same mistakes came back launch after launch.

One unified system that runs the whole launch, end to end, with a person deciding at every step that needs judgement. It ships as a Claude Agent Skill ("Steve, the AI Program launcher") that each team runs in its own chair, on the same files, with the same rules.

items: Product manager's chair. The programme sheet is read in, a ten-question intake gate fills what is missing, and the market positioning is researched and recorded. Every section's words are drafted from the sources the PM gave (never invented: a doubt is asked, not guessed) and approved on a Page Content web page, where a fast, cheap agent makes each change the PM asks for. On page zero the PM picks up to three reference brochures from a library and says, in their own words, what to take from each.

The build. A design director turns those picks into a brief; the pages are built, measured and exported to a print-intent PDF. Page height is predicted to about 3% of the real render before anything is drawn, so nothing is clipped. A complete 29-page draft comes out in one pass.
Content team's chair. Draft 1 goes out for approval from the PM's own Gmail, and the reviewers' comments come back as tracked items, each closed or answered, never lost in a thread.

Designer's chair. The approved pages are handed over as a package and rebuilt natively in Adobe Illustrator behind identity and editability gates (live text, real layers, no flattened pictures of words), then finished in a pair room where Claude, Adobe and the designer work on the same file together.
Rules are build failures, not advice. House style, locked boilerplate, spelling, banned claims, copy floors per course, stat sources and their age: a draft that breaks one does not export.

Images are licensed or they do not ship. The design team's own assets come first; anything else is searched, judged on a contact sheet by a person, and recorded with its source, licence and credit, above a 2000 px print floor.
Every step is recorded in order. The flow lives in code: the next missing step is printed with its exact question, and Draft 1 is refused while a step is missing.

Model routing. Drafting runs on the session's own model; the Page Content edits run on a small, fast model; the learners, director and builders are separate agents that resume where they stopped instead of starting over.

blocks.text: Every person's edits, in every chair, are captured by a learning pipeline and turned into rules and references for the next launch: what a designer fixed by hand becomes a check the build makes itself. Tested versions are released to everyone at once, and each session updates itself to the latest release before it starts.

items: 88 versions in eleven weeks (v1 in August 2026 to v88 in late October), each tested and released.
156 scripts and 166 tests behind one skill.
Three teams, one tool: product, content and design work from the same files, the same rules and the same history.
In use as an internal tool for programme launches.

blocks.text: Claude Agent Skills, Python, multi-agent orchestration (director, drafters, learners, builders), Haiku for fast edits, Google Drive, Sheets and Gmail, Adobe Illustrator through its connector, PyMuPDF for measuring PDFs, GitHub releases for versioning.

items.title: AI-Powered Osteoarthritis Classification & Reporting
items.summary: Knee X-ray to a doctor's report in under two minutes: Kellgren–Lawrence grading at 98% accuracy and AUC, double-checked by segmentation of the radiological findings, tested in a randomised controlled trial and deployed at Fortis.
items.body: A doctor uploads a knee X-ray. In under two minutes the system grades the osteoarthritis, finds and measures every radiological finding, writes the report and forwards it to the doctor.

blocks.text: A doctor uploads a knee X-ray. In under two minutes the system grades the osteoarthritis, finds and measures every radiological finding, writes the report and forwards it to the doctor.

items: Grade. A classification model grades the X-ray on the Kellgren–Lawrence (KL) scale at 98% accuracy and AUC.
Find. Purpose-built image segmentation models locate the radiological findings: osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis and the gap between the joints (joint-space narrowing).
Double-check. The findings are matched against the step-1 grade, so a grade the evidence doesn't support is caught before it reaches a doctor.
Measure. The system calculates the length and area of each finding.
Report. It writes the report and forwards it to the doctor, end to end in less than two minutes.

blocks.text: Every model was custom-built in-house, with patent filings and FDA approval in mind.

items: Tested at SRM, Trichy as part of a randomised controlled trial of osteoarthritis patients, under the supervision of Dr. Mahesh Magadum.
More than 90% concordance with radiologists; outperformed competitor RBKnee.
Deployed and scaled at Fortis Hospital, Nagarbhavi, Bengaluru.
TensorFlow for every model: the KL classifier and the segmentation models.
Training and inference on AWS EC2 with an H100 GPU cluster.
Serving through AWS Lambda functions behind API Gateway, with the report delivered to the doctor.

blocks.text: He led the clinicians and engineers who delivered it. Earlier, as an intern, he ran EDA on DICOM images and built the baseline classifiers (logistic regression, random forest) before the move to deep learning. Follow-on research, "OA Classification and Reporting using Agentic AI and Deep Neural Networks", is ongoing with OsteosConnect.

items.title: AI Portfolio Agent (this site)
items.summary: Dumbledore, a Python LangGraph agent live on this site — hybrid RAG, a five-gate refusal pipeline, page navigation and 17 free LLMs on a ₹0/month stack.
items.body: Status: live in production on this site (rishabh-hota.vercel.app) since October 2026, serving real visitors, with error monitoring (Sentry) and evals on every push. The agent is called Dumbledore; the chat window is just its…

items: Status: live in production on this site (rishabh-hota.vercel.app) since October 2026, serving real visitors, with error monitoring (Sentry) and evals on every push. The agent is called Dumbledore; the chat window is just its interface.
Agent: a LangGraph graph in Python (FastAPI on Vercel):
route: greetings, contact questions and "take me to …" requests get an instant answer with no LLM call;

retrieve: hybrid search, combining FAISS for meaning (BAAI bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings, run inside the server with the same model on Cloudflare as the backup) with BM25 for keywords, merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion. A cross-encoder re-ranker was A/B-tested and kept off (MRR@4 0.885 vs 0.962);

respond: 17 free LLMs across Groq, Gemini, Cloudflare Workers AI and OpenRouter, picked by question difficulty (fact, standard, reasoning). Budgets are reserved atomically in Redis, so many visitors at once never overload one model, and the switch between models is invisible.

Refusal pipeline: five gates keep it on topic — rules, then a meaning check against on-topic and off-topic examples (both before any LLM), the prompt, an output check on every sentence before the visitor sees it (code and leaked instructions replaced; unknown links, phone numbers and other emails removed), and a cache that stores only clean answers. On 76 attack and off-topic prompts (follow-ups included): 0 leaks. On held-out prompts it refused 32 of 33, 24 of them before any LLM, with 0 false refusals on 47 real recruiter questions.

Agent actions: it takes visitors to the page they ask for ("open the LCSNet paper") and offers "take me there" buttons under answers. Targets come from an allow-list of the site's own pages, so no one can be sent elsewhere.
Answer bank: common questions, asked any way, are answered instantly from checked answers: an embedding match with a safety margin (0 wrong answers on held-out paraphrases).
Security: a Next.js gateway in front of the agent checks for bots, validates input, rate-limits per visitor and enforces a daily budget.
Memory: lives only in the visitor's open tab. When the chat or the site is closed, it's gone, and only a short AI summary is logged to a Google Sheet.
Evals: Python suites check retrieval, facts, guardrails, refusals, navigation and difficulty routing; RAGAS scores faithfulness, answer relevancy and context precision.

items.title: TurboTrade — Zerodha MCP trading copilot
items.summary: A chat copilot that researches, plans and trades Indian markets using LangChain, Groq and Zerodha's Kite MCP.
items.body: TurboTrade puts research, planning and trading on Indian markets into one chat.

blocks.text: TurboTrade puts research, planning and trading on Indian markets into one chat.
A user can ask: "Show my live P&L, scan for bullish breakouts, then sell half my HDFC Bank."

items: LangChain handles orchestration, Groq provides fast reasoning, and the Zerodha Kite MCP server streams secure, real-time account data.
The agent fetches positions through MCP, blends fresh news using LangChain RAG, and streams insights.
One-tap options let the user buy, sell, set stops or queue deeper research.
MCP keeps API keys out of prompts, and OAuth scopes guard capital.
Every step is logged and reversible.
Models and brokers can be swapped, and custom research feeds plugged in, without rewrites.
Built to stay compliant with Indian rules.
